- Batch B has 4 more than twice Batch A: B = 2x + 4
- Batch C has 10 fewer than Batch B: C = (2x + 4) - 10 = 2x - 6

Total:
x + (2x + 4) + (2x - 6) = 98
5x - 2 = 98
5x = 100
x = 20

So:
A = 20
B = 2(20) + 4 = 44
C = 44 - 10 = 34

Check: 20 + 44 + 34 = 98
